# Continual-ARC puzzle solving

Use this skill when solving ARC-style grid puzzles in a continual evaluation stream, especially when each task has an id, test grid, optional demo requests, per-instance attempt costs, and a required persistent Python solver library.

## Operating contract

1. Treat the puzzle protocol in the current user message as authoritative. It may prescribe file paths, action JSON, attempt caps, demo caps, and post-verdict behavior.

4. If no solver exists, reason from the provided input and demonstrations. Request another demo only when its expected information is worth its explicit cost and the cap permits it. Account for the attempt budget: an unsuccessful instance may incur the full budget, so avoid speculative submissions.
